description: We are high school students who are passionate about learning, researching SPACE.
summary:
DSD SENSE – Understanding Earth’s Environmental Changes

DSD SENSE is a project that uses NASA Earth observation data to understand environmental changes around the world. Our main goal is to discover what is changing, where these changes are happening, and how much they are changing.

We will focus on land surface temperature and compare two different geographical regions over time. Using NASA satellite data, we will create graphs and maps to show temperature changes. We will also use statistical methods to understand if these changes show a significant trend.

Our project aims to make complex scientific data easier to understand and help people explore environmental changes at a regional level. In the future, we hope to include more environmental variables, such as soil moisture and vegetation.

DSD SENSE helps us discover, analyze, and understand the changes happening on Earth.
details:
DSD SENSE – Project Details

DSD SENSE is a project that aims to help people understand environmental changes on Earth. Our project will focus on land surface temperature and compare changes in two different geographical regions over time.

We plan to use NASA Earth observation data to study changes on Earth’s surface. We aim to explore NASA data using NASA Giovanni and analyze the information using Google Colab. We also plan to create maps and graphs to show temperature changes. Statistical methods, such as the Mann-Kendall test and Sen’s Slope, may help us understand these trends.

Our project aims to show what is changing, where changes are happening, and how significant these changes are.

The creative idea behind DSD SENSE is to make complex scientific information simple, visual, and easy to understand. We want to help people explore regional environmental changes instead of looking only at global averages.

In the future, we hope to include more environmental variables, such as soil moisture and vegetation.
